notes: Gameplay run-bed candidates. Two inputs define the sound (see MUSIC_SCENE_BRIEF.md): the main-menu cathedral painting, translated into the caption's scene block, and the Ballance sound pack the project already carries (src/renderer/assets/audio/dont_modify/, the full 40-file rip), passed as reference_audio blends. Build the blends first: build-ambience-reference-mix.py --list run-bed-references-ballance-music.txt --seconds-per-source 6 --out reference-audio/Ballance_music_mix.wav and --list run-bed-references-ballance-all.txt --seconds-per-source 1.5 --crossfade 0.4 --out reference-audio/Ballance_all_mix.wav. Render with `yarn audio:ace-step:run-bed`, score with pick-ace-takes.py, cut the winner with make-seamless-loop.py into src/renderer/assets/audio/music/run-loop.wav. Reference audio guides style only; the Ballance files themselves are never shipped as music (see RIGHTS.md).
